Application Data.NAME: Acme Medical Supplies, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Acme Medical Supplies, Inc. operates as a retail store specializing in the sale of medical and hospital equipment, supplies, and related products. Our offerings include personal protective equipment (PPE), surgical instruments, diagnostic machines, and other healthcare essentials. We maintain a diverse inventory valued at over $1 million, with a focus on quality and compliance with industry standards. We also have a growing online sales platform that accounts for less than 50% of our total revenue. Our dedicated team works closely with healthcare professionals to ensure they have access to the supplies they need, supported by a robust logistics and delivery operation. We prioritize the safety and reliability of our products while maintaining strong safety protocols to minimize risks associated with inventory storage and delivery.
